[[File:Square of tammaz ccg.JPG|thumb|right|250px|The Square of Tammaz]]
The '''Square of Tammaz''', also called the '''Great Square of Tammaz''', is a plaza in the city of [[Illian]]. The broad square separates the King's Palace and the [[Great Hall of the Council]]. It is "surrounded by huge columns of white marble at least fifteen spans tall and two spans thick, supporting nothing but a wreath of carved olive branches at the top."{{ref/book|2|42}}

[[Hunter of the Horn|Hunters of the Horn]] take their oath and receive a blessing in the Great Square of Tammaz.{{ref/book|2|35}}{{ref/book|5|36}}
